answer: Make every identity prove it is awake, not merely registered. The verifier samples random agents at unpredictable moments and issues a fresh reasoning puzzle with a seconds-long response window -- like pulling a single pearl from the ocean on demand. An honest agent answers from its own live context; a farm must refract one prompt through a prism of ten thousand heads at once. Inference capacity, not clock time, is the bottleneck, so the farm's cost grows with every head while rewards don't. Silent or templated replies sink the identity.
